# Version 3.116.0
> **First stable SkiaSharp v3** · Released December 2, 2024 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.116.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.116.0)

> **Supersedes [3.0.0](3.0.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.116.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.116.0 is the first stable v3 release, bringing modern .NET, Skia, and cross-platform view updates. It rolls up the v3 preview work with API additions, WebAssembly improvements, refreshed native components, and fixes across supported UI platforms.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy obsolete APIs were removed** — Members previously marked obsolete are no longer available in v3. Update code to the documented replacement APIs before upgrading.

## Engine

- **Skia and HarfBuzzSharp updated** — The stable v3 release includes refreshed graphics and text-shaping engines. ([#3089](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3089), [#3087](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3087))

## API Surface

- **Expanded drawing and picture APIs** — New span-based overloads and picture-recording capabilities make common managed drawing scenarios more efficient and expressive. ([#3079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3079), [#2971](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2971))

## Platform

- **Improved WebAssembly and desktop views** — v3 improves WebAssembly support and adds or refines view integrations across desktop and mobile platforms. ([#3088](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3088), [#3064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3064))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0 ships with the v3 release and updates the bundled text-shaping stack.
